morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为计量单位名称记忆；两个e均读é /e/，不是央元音/ə/。数据包音节字段为空；DBP标注为gé.lén。

senses.zh_definition: 加仑；本词的DBP释义指英制液体容量单位，一加仑约等于4.55升，精确值为4.54609升。
senses.en_definition: An imperial gallon, a unit of liquid capacity equal to exactly 4.54609 litres.
senses.ms_definition: Unit sukatan cecair yang bersamaan dengan 4.55 liter.
senses.nuances: DBP释义中的4.55升是约数。跨国资料须区分gelen imperial与gelen AS；美制液体加仑约为3.785升。不能仅因容器俗称“一加仑桶”便认定其实际容量。[DBP：gelen](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=gelen)；[容量换算表](https://www.pgccphy.net/thermo/thermo.pdf)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Laporan itu menyatakan bahawa tangki tersebut berkapasiti sepuluh gelen imperial, iaitu kira-kira 45.46 liter.
dual_scenarios.zh: 报告指出，该储罐的容量为十英制加仑，即约45.46升。
dual_scenarios.en: The report states that the tank holds ten imperial gallons, approximately 45.46 litres.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Bekas ni muat satu gelen air je ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah bekas ini hanya dapat memuatkan satu gelen air?
dual_scenarios.zh: 这个容器只能装一加仑水啊？
dual_scenarios.en: Does this container only hold one gallon of water?

messages.ms_spoken: Bekas ni muat satu gelen air je ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah bekas ini hanya dapat memuatkan satu gelen air?
messages.zh: 这个容器只能装一加仑水啊？
messages.en: Does this container only hold one gallon of water?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, satu gelen imperial. Aku dah semak label kat bawah tu.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, satu gelen imperial. Saya sudah menyemak label di bahagian bawah bekas itu.
messages.zh: 对，一英制加仑。我看过底下的标签了。
messages.en: Yes, one imperial gallon. I checked the label underneath.

etymology.historical_story: Gelen corresponds to English gallon, whose history leads through Middle English and Anglo-Norman French to medieval words for a pail or liquid measure. That container background makes the unit memorable. Malay dictionaries specify approximately 4.55 litres, linking this entry to the imperial gallon; American liquid gallons represent a different quantity despite sharing the English name. [Oxford: gallon](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/gallon); [DBP: gelen](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=gelen)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把gé-lén和“加仑”配对：脑中画一个标着4.55 L的桶；遇到美国标签，再确认单位。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 这是中性的计量词。交易中可礼貌询问“Ini gelen imperial atau gelen AS?”，确认对方采用的单位。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 报价、采购和技术说明应写明加仑制式，必要时同时列出升数；描述容器时以容量标签为准。
